message: Ah, yes...save early, save often. Have you tried [OpenOffice](http://www.openoffice.org/)? It can open any .doc file, as well as other file extensions, but I don't know how it works for Macs. [Abiword](http://www.abisource.com/) is good too. I ditched Microsoft Word over a year ago; I'd had it for about three years, and all of a sudden, every time I tried to open it, it would give me that "illegal operation and will be shut down" garbage.
